validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" initial="a">
  <state id="a">
    <onentry><cancel/></onentry>
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: cancel requires exactly one of `sendid` or `sendidexpr`
notes: `<cancel>` identifies exactly one delayed `<send>` to cancel, either literally (`sendid`) or computed (`sendidexpr`)
diagnostics.help: use `sendid` for a literal send ID or `sendidexpr` for a computed ID

fixes.message: add the `sendid` of the `<send>` to cancel
